name: Start Microsoft Defender quick scan (Windows)
description: Starts a Defender quick scan and waits a limited time for it to finish. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When enabled, nothing is changed and the script only prints what it would do.

output: [DRY-RUN] or [DONE]/[SKIP] lines. Exit 0; exit 3 if Defender is not usable.
